metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the macos-def_plist511_test is properly supported
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the macos-def:plist511_test.

criterion.comment: Test that the plist511_object is supported with the filepath entity equal to some value.

plist511_test.comment: Test that the plist511_object is supported with the filepath entity equal to some value.

plist511_object.comment: Retrieve the value for DarkWakeBackgroundTasks from /Library/Preferences/com.apple.PowerManagement.plist.
